title: Find the secret ingredient
brief: In this recipe, one ingredient is misspelled as 'suger' instead of 'sugar'. Find and fix all occurrences.
text:
Add 100 g suger
Mix with 50 ml water
Stir in more suger
Bake until golden
Check the suger level

expect.text:
Add 100 g sugar
Mix with 50 ml water
Stir in more sugar
Bake until golden
Check the sugar level

why: Global substitution finds and replaces all instances of a pattern in one command, saving manual search-and-replace.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use :%s/old/new/g to replace everywhere in the buffer.
